research_objective: Determine whether materially different public research paradigms improve the existing Crypto development system, or whether the remaining bottleneck is data representation and coverage.

frontier_map.native_input: daily OHLCV transformed into 158 k-bar, price and rolling features
frontier_map.native_target: cross-sectionally normalized next-day close return after one-day execution delay
frontier_map.model_search: LightGBM regression with a fixed workflow
frontier_map.cost: 5bp open plus 15bp close in the published workflow
frontier_map.evaluation: IC, Rank IC, ICIR and portfolio analysis
frontier_map.main_assumption: cross-sectional supervised prediction preserves more information than formula admission
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: changes representation, target and portfolio instead of adding formula operators

frontier_map.native_input: minute crypto bars across fourteen assets
frontier_map.model_search: LightGBM used by all top-three competition teams
frontier_map.portfolio_mapping: none in competition; weighted forecast correlation
frontier_map.main_assumption: explicit residualized forecasting target is more learnable than direct strategy reward
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: separates forecast skill from portfolio and cost

frontier_map.native_input: volatility-normalized multi-horizon returns and MACD sequences
frontier_map.native_target: no detached label; position is optimized against next-day portfolio return
frontier_map.model_search: shared LSTM position model trained by differentiable Sharpe
frontier_map.cost: turnover regularization and 0-3bp published cost tests
frontier_map.main_assumption: joint trend and sizing learning preserves edge lost by signal-first evaluation
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: optimizes the portfolio rather than exact signal identities

frontier_map.native_input: one-year sequences, multi-scale normalized returns, MACD and optional changepoints
frontier_map.main_assumption: attention identifies long dependencies and regime changes
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: learned temporal representation replaces fixed temporal primitives

frontier_map.native_input: multi-asset sequences with lagged cross-section and economic graph
frontier_map.native_target: pooled portfolio Sharpe plus soft-min window Sharpe
frontier_map.model_search: graph and cross-asset attention with exact coupled-Sharpe gradients
frontier_map.portfolio_mapping: direct multi-asset positions with cost-aware objective
frontier_map.main_assumption: causal cross-asset structure and worst-regime loss improve robustness
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: changes both representation and stability objective

frontier_map.native_input: multi-level limit-order-book states at event or sub-second frequency
frontier_map.model_search: CNN/Inception plus LSTM or temporal CNN
frontier_map.main_assumption: spatial order-book state contains predictive information absent from bars
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: requires a fundamentally richer data representation

frontier_map.native_input: lookback tensor across assets and channels
frontier_map.native_target: future return tensor used directly by portfolio losses
frontier_map.main_assumption: allocation is part of learning rather than a post-processing step

frontier_map.native_input: market state, holdings and account state
frontier_map.main_assumption: sequential actions and inventory state matter

frontier_map.native_input: Qlib stock panel and expression grammar
frontier_map.main_assumption: sets of complementary formulas dominate single-formula search
frontier_map.challenge_to_current_system: joint pool reward counters exact-identity collapse

dataset.daily_observable_time: next UTC day 00:00 after a completed daily bucket
dataset.missing_policy: no cross-symbol fill; missing coordinates remain absent; train-only median feature imputation
dataset.label: close[t+2] / close[t+1] - 1

dmn_reproduction.native_deviation: 252-day return and one-year sequence are unavailable inside the qualified ten-month release; no claim about the full Momentum Transformer is permitted.
